title: Garden and Spire
author: Ivo Kavanagh
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
